reused_source.inspection: Read full source in private cache; no original user saves opened
reused_source.reuse_kind: Algorithm pattern only; new typed validation/canonical envelope implementation. No wholesale source copy.
reused_pattern: preserve corrupt primary before explicit repair
changed_contract: digest covers all metadata and payload
map update returns DEFERRED without fabricated coordinates
phase observer enables process termination tests

requirements: RQ-102 (process termination subset, not Android lifecycle)
input_dependency_scope: All generated fixture IDs, map dimensions, equipment, names and quantities are explicitly synthetic. No missing P1.5 private data or NA reference rows are dependencies. Entire G0 remains separately judged.

limits.durability: FileAccess.flush + same-directory rename observed per target runtime. No fsync directory/power-loss durability claim. No true disk-full hardware test.
limits.checksum: Accidental corruption only; not a signature or account authentication.
limits.migration: Only same stable map with still-valid coordinates can be updated. Otherwise DEFERRED and source retained. No old map coordinate transformation invented.
